meta.purpose: Per-model LLM token pricing used to estimate and bill demo generation cost. Prices are per 1,000,000 tokens, split by input (prompt) and output (completion).
owner_todo: LLM pricing drifts - re-verify against the source URLs and bump checked_at periodically.
Currencies are mixed: Anthropic/OpenAI/Mistral bill in USD, Scaleway in EUR. Normalize with a live FX rate before summing across providers; do not hardcode a rate here.

Prompt-cache rates are encoded per row: `cached_input` (READ, ~0.1x base on Anthropic), `cache_write` (WRITE at the default/5-minute TTL, 1.25x base) and `cache_write_1h` (WRITE at the 1-hour TTL, 2x base). Keep all three verified alongside input/output. A row without them bills that tier at the input rate, which under-bills any provider that surcharges cache writes. Still NOT encoded: Anthropic & Scaleway Batch API (-50%), OpenAI Flex/Priority tiers.

gpt-5.6-terra carries cache_write 5.00 (2.5x its input rate) and no 1-hour tier. Nothing on the OpenAI-compatible path reports a cache-WRITE counter today, so the rate is encoded but never applied - revisit if a provider starts reporting one.
Scaleway also hosts Mistral/Qwen/Llama/gpt-oss at EUR rates; add scaleway/* rows if you route those models through Scaleway instead of the native provider.
Add context_window / max_output columns if the estimator needs them.

gpt-5.6-terra: one secondary source reported a long-context meter (4.00/18.00 for requests over ~272K input tokens); NOT confirmed by the owner-supplied rates and NOT encoded. Verify before trusting long-run cost figures.

gpt-5.6-terra has a LONG-CONTEXT meter (~272K+ input tokens bills the entire request at 4.00 in / 18.00 out) that this flat-rate table cannot express - a dev run that crosses the threshold is under-billed here. Encode a context-tiered rate, or bill Terra long runs manually, before pricing decisions rest on it.

Bill by `api_model` (the exact usage-reported model string), NOT `id`; an unknown model string must fail loud, never bill 0. The in-use Mistral rows now carry `api_model`; add it (and `type` if embedding) to the anthropic/openai/scaleway rows before routing projects to them.

Embedding tokens are billable and now included: pgvector RAG ingestion (whole knowledge repo + CVE feeds) and every retrieval query run through mistral-embed - meter them like chat input tokens. Reranker (currently unset in .env) has no row yet; add one if you route to a token-billed reranker.

field_reference.api_model: THE BILLING LOOKUP KEY: the exact model string the OpenAI-compatible endpoint returns in its usage/model field (e.g. "mistral-large-latest", "mistral-embed"). Look prices up by this, NOT by `id`. May be a single string or an array of aliases. An unknown api_model must fail loud - never bill 0.
field_reference.provider: Billing vendor / API endpoint the price applies to (anthropic, openai, scaleway, mistral).
field_reference.type: "chat" (input + output tokens; the default when absent) or "embedding" (input tokens only, output = 0).
field_reference.output: Cost per 1,000,000 output (completion) tokens, in `currency`. 0 for embedding models.
field_reference.cached_input: Optional: cost per 1,000,000 prompt-cache READ tokens (the provider-reported cached subset of input), in `currency`. Absent = cached reads bill at `input` (no discount).
field_reference.currency: USD or EUR. See owner_todo on normalization.
field_reference.cache_write: Optional. Price per 1M tokens WRITTEN to the prompt cache (cache_creation_input_tokens), default/5-minute TTL. Anthropic charges 1.25x base input for it. Absent = writes bill at the input rate (an under-bill for any provider that surcharges them).
field_reference.cache_write_1h: Optional. Price per 1M tokens written to the 1-HOUR-TTL cache, which Anthropic charges at 2x base input. Absent = 1-hour writes fall back to cache_write. Only providers with a second cache tier need it.

models.notes: 2.00/10.00 is the STANDARD price: the increase to 3.00/15.00 scheduled for 2026-09-01 was cancelled and the launch rate made permanent. Verified 2026-08-29.
Rates supplied by the instance owner 2026-08-29. Cache WRITES bill 5.00/M on top and have no column here - see owner_todo; on a dev run that is not a rounding error.

cached_input = 10% of input per Mistral prompt-caching policy (verified 2026-08-10; opt-in via prompt_cache_key, which the platform sends on dev runs and project chat).
